text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup
on:
  copilot:
    types: [preinstall]

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          toolchain: 1.88.0

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org

      - name: Set up just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: 1.6.0

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: cargo install cargo-binstall
        shell: bash

      - name: Install development tools
        run: |
          cargo binstall -y watchexec-cli cargo-insta typos-cli cargo-shear dprint
        shell: bash

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify tool versions
        run: |
          just --version
          cargo --version
          rustc --version
          node --version
          pnpm --version
          watchexec --version
          cargo insta --version
          typos --version
          cargo shear --version
          dprint --version
        shell: bash

      - name: Run cargo check
        run: cargo check
        shell: bash

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "Copilot environment setup complete. Available commands: just ready, just fmt, just test, just lint."
```
